summary: GSK plc filed a routine Form 6-K disclosing PDMR share dealings under the UK Market Abuse Regulation, equivalent to a US Form 4 insider transaction notice. Four executives—CEO Luke Miels, President Europe Lynn Baxter, Group General Counsel James Ford, and President Corporate Development David Redfern—each acquired ordinary shares of 31 pence at GBP 17.5852 on 2026-10-08 through dividend reinvestment in the Company's Share Reward Plan. Volumes were de minimis (3, 39, 13 and 80 shares), all executed on the London Stock Exchange. No board recommendation, advisor, stake change, or structural event is present; no risk-arb angle applies.
